notes.title: Black Screen Issue
notes.content:
Hello everyone~

Thank you for your patience!

There was an issue with some people experiencing a black screen when launching the game. The issue seemed to be with finding the System Save File when the file path contained characters from some languages like Russian among others.

The update should fix this problem, thank you!

notes.title: In Game Movie File Color Adjustment
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

There seemed to be any issue with the in game movie files being rendered with incorrect colors. Videos such as the opening movie after the first few events, the credit movie, etc. They should be the correct colors now.

We are aware of some other issues as well and are looking into them! Thank you!
